label: RBM15::MRTFA

sections.text: RBM15 encodes an RNA-binding protein that recruits RNA-modification machinery.
MRTFA encodes a transcriptional coactivator of serum-response factor linked to actin dynamics.

The t(1;22) fusion joins an RNA-associated regulator to a serum-response-factor coactivator and dysregulates hematopoietic transcription. It is characteristic of a subset of infant non-Down-syndrome acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.
